"anim" : "fadedrop", "dur" : 300 }, "items" : "voidanim" } } } Great Wines of the Andes Hong Kong 2018 — Official Guidebook June 11 @ 8:00 am - 5:00 pm Event Navigation Great Wines of the Andes USA 2018 » Following the success of the past three years in the United States, we decided to bring Great Wines of the Andes to Hong Kong this year. Gathering nearly 40 leading producers from the Chile, Argentina and Uruguay, this new Asia edition showcases a diversity of wines, including a number of perfect wines rated at 100 points. As you may know, the 100-point Almaviva Puente Alto 2015 from Chile was our Wine of the Year in 2017, and this really shows how the region is really on top of its winemaking game. While Chile shows limitless quality , Argentina continues to push the envelope and make bold yet balanced reds and whites. Uruguay is also a wine gem not to be overlooked. Although Uruguay is technically not part of the Andes, Bodega Garzón is a dynamic South American winery that adds great interest to our events. With its remarkable microclimates and high-altitude vineyards, the Andes has continually impressed us with great wines that reflect a sense of place. And we are so excited to share these top-scoring wines with you at the Great Wines of the Andes in Hong Kong. For all the detailed winery profiles and the list of Top 100 Wines of the Andes 2017 , download the official Great Wines of the Andes Hong Kong 2018 guidebook . We hope to see you at the event and hear what you think about these exciting wines. Cheers! SHARE ON:
